menuSearchImage.description: Context menu entry shown on images.

overlayClose.description: Close button tooltip on the selection overlay.

viewerOffline.description: Status when the pre-check cannot reach Google.

optionsShortcutGroup.description: Options section heading for the keyboard shortcut.

optionsNotAssigned.description: Shortcut placeholder when nothing is assigned.

optionsSaved.description: Transient confirmation after changing a setting.
